news.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
news.summary: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

news.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
news.summary: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

news.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
news.summary: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

news.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
news.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

news.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

news.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
news.summary: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

news.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
news.summary: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

news.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
news.summary: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

news.title: What gave this city its ‘best place to retire’ crown? You can actually afford to live there.
news.summary: Low cost of living, high quality of life and favorable taxes for retirees, for the win.

news.title: Amazon’s stock drops — even in the face of a bold new cloud forecast
news.summary: Modest AWS results and weak advertising growth left Wall Street disappointed in Amazon’s third-quarter earnings

news.title: A Starbucks turnaround is brewing — but perhaps not quickly enough for investors
news.summary: The coffee chain beat expectations on a key sales metric, but its stock was still moving lower.

news.title: Sandisk sees revenue nearly quintuple — and a stock split is on the way
news.summary: Sandisk’s stock has climbed more than 2,600% since the company separated from Western Digital 20 months ago — and it has one of the highest prices in the S&P 500.

news.title: Our church has a $1.5 million bequest earning 3.75% in a bank account. Is inflation eroding it?
news.summary: “Given the size and long-term nature of this gift, we want to make sure the funds are managed prudently.”

news.title: Why Intel’s stock is sinking toward its worst drop in two years
news.summary: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

news.title: My abusive ex-husband promised $20,000 for our kids’ education. Now he refuses to pay. Is he legally obligated?
news.summary: “Before our divorce, my former mother-in-law entrusted him with $20,000 for each of our daughters to invest on their behalf.”
